samples.xml_description:
<module id="JC_counter">
    <description>64-bit Johnson counter (torsional ring counter).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the counter.</input>
        <output id="Q" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit register representing the current count value.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Sequential logic to update the counter on each rising edge of the clock or falling edge of the reset.
        If rst_n is low, reset Q to 0.
        Otherwise, shift Q[63:1] to the right and append Q[0] shifted left by 63 bits.
    </implementation>
</module>
